title: "Defining and Implementing Traits"

# Defining and Implementing Traits
Traits define shared behavior analogous to interfaces:

```rust
pub trait Summary {
    fn summarize(&self) -> String;
}

pub struct Article {
    pub headline: String,
}

impl Summary for Article {
    fn summarize(&self) -> String {
        format!("Headline: {}", self.headline)
    }
}

fn main() {
    let a = Article { headline: "Rust 2026 Ships".into() };
    println!("{}", a.summarize());
}
```
